decisions.reason: Step 5.1 omits the positive index range: with zero-based naturals, I_0=(1,2) has zero indicator in L2([0,1]), so the stated family is not linearly independent. This is nonfatal because the dimension aside is not used in the kernel, trace-class, resolvent or trace/determinant argument. Explicitly restricting to integers n>=1 gives disjoint intervals inside [0,1] of measure 2^(-n)>0; restriction to each interval then proves every coefficient vanishes. The omission is repaired without weakening the claim.

reviews.reason: Checked the full example, its declared supplier interfaces, owning contract and examples page. Positive-index dyadic indicators now prove infinite dimensionality. The triangle kernel has squared L2 norm 1/2; the supplied Hilbert-Schmidt product result applies after compactness and basis existence under AC. Fubini on bounded step functions proves the power kernel, density extends it, and the factorial bound makes the nonzero resolvent series converge on both sides. Nonempty spectrum and the separable quasinilpotent trace lemma give spectrum {0}, trace zero and determinant one; V^2(1)=x^2/2 verifies the page claim of nonzeroness. Also corrected the spectral-inclusion reference from step 3.1 to step 4.1. This is the repair author's verification, not independent review of the new text.
